infotext.entitydescription.ekutility_advancedhead: The perfect headset. Equipped with noise suppression, high frequency emitters, and adjustable comfort suspension, this headset is designed for onboard use by submarine crews muffling loud noises and improving quiet ones when using dive suits while protecting the users hearing and inner ear. 300m Range
infotext.entitydescription.batterycelldisposable: A dangerous attempt at solving the portable power crisis on Europa, This high output rechargeable chemical battery is prone to thermal run away and explode when used continously or when struck against a hard surface. Though it can be placed on a charger, if it begins to smoke it may be safer to just deconstruct or throw it away immediately.
infotext.entitydescription.ekutility_longrangerad: A portable radio pack. Equipped with noise suppression, rotating high frequency emitters, and adjustable comfort suspension, this headset is designed for onboard use by submarine crews its atomic pile will last for years of constant use, while only slowing the wearer down a small amount. In addition to the general carrying space there are two ammo pouches and the headset 'ear scout' system drastically reduces divesuit muffling. 800m Range
infotext.entitydescription.ek_security_radio: A low-profile radio transceiver used mainly by ship and station security officers, this coalition special forces setup is excellent for diving teams as the long range radio frequency minimizes distortions from naturally occurring sources by using ULF in a relatively compact package. 500m Range
infotext.entitydescription.BTCpressureinjectorhea: A field modifed injector headset designed specifically for pressure stabilizer, quickly injects the wearer if it detects Organ Damage while under High Pressure. Monitors the users vitals and sends out a SOS beacon should they become incapciatated including paralyzation or heart conditions, which will disengage once the user is stabilized or expires. 250m Range

Override.entitydescription.autoinjectorheadset: A modifed headset utilizing an integrated battery, capable of injecting medicine placed within once the user's vitals drop to a certain level. Monitors the users vitals and sends out a SOS beacon should they become incapciatated including paralyzation or heart conditions, which will disengage once the user is stabilized or expires. 250m Range

infotext.missiondescription.salvagekillcarrier: A small cargo vessel went missing approximately two months ago when transporting xenomaterials from [location1] to [location2]. The vessel was presumed to be taken by the abyss, but now its emergency beacon seems to have been activated near [location2]. Find the vessel and recover the cargo.
infotext.missionsuccess.salvagekillcarrier: The researchers of [location2] are eager to know all the details of the encounter, but seem hesitant to answer any questions regarding the vessel. They do, however, offer you 2000 credits as "reimbursement for your troubles".
